verdict.rationale: Formant's docs state that events can trigger commands, such as running scripts or returning a robot home, and that a Formant event can fire webhooks to any HTTP endpoint. Marketing pages add anomaly alerts and automated incident response, so the core event-to-action automation is documented first-party. Missing for 10: detail on how rule conditions are authored (thresholds, filters, chaining), any programmatic or AI-native way to define rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
